definitions.explanation: A structure or barrier that encloses or surrounds an area. Can refer to fences, pens for animals, walled-off areas, or partitions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{囲|かこ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{囲|かこ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鶏|にわとり}→鶏：05202_niwatori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っている→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧。
examples.english: Chickens are running around inside the enclosure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{囲|かこ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられている→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: A fence has been set up around the construction site.

notes:
Derived from the verb ⟦{囲|かこ}う→囲う：12005_kakou⟧ (to surround, to enclose). Refers to physical barriers of various kinds — fences, pens, walls, partitions, or hoarding around construction sites.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {囲|かこ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to build an enclosure
- {囲|かこ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: inside the enclosure
- {囲|かこ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to set up a fence/barrier
- {囲|かこ}い⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to leave the enclosure

TYPES:
- ⟦{柵|さく}→柵：13103_saku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{囲|かこ}い: fence enclosure
- ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{囲|かこ}い: stone enclosure
- ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{囲|かこ}い: construction hoarding

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{囲|かこ}う→囲う：12005_kakou⟧: the source verb (to surround)
- ⟦{柵|さく}→柵：13103_saku⟧: fence, railing (more specifically a fence structure)
- ⟦{塀|へい}→塀：03613_hei⟧: wall (solid barrier, typically of stone or concrete)
